frozen_manifest_unit.title: Maximum-entropy biasing source with no preassigned Rules family
frozen_manifest_unit.challenge_intent: Test that an unassigned source with a target observable and biasing model is not auto-routed to a new family or operator.

source_first_pass_a.scientific_question: Can a maximum-entropy simulation-biasing paper be routed without a preassigned family or a new operator?

source_identity_and_locators.citation: Pitera and Chodera (2012), On the Use of Experimental Observations to Bias Simulated Ensembles, Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation.

exact_pdf_locators.scope: maximum-entropy restraints, target observables, and biasing-weight limitations.
experimental observables as geometrically sensitive, equilibrium information.

source_objects.native_observable: Experimental observations sensitive to molecular geometry, combined with simulation-coordinate functions in a maximum-entropy formulation.
source_objects.estimand: A minimally biased ensemble consistent with observations under specified restraint/biasing assumptions.
source_objects.statistical_unit: Experimental observation and simulated ensemble/coordinate representation in the methods formulation.
source_objects.spatial_support: Molecular geometry observables such as distances and angles in the source's general setup.
source_objects.temporal_or_ensemble_semantics: The source frames experimental information as equilibrium ensemble constraints.
source_objects.transformations_and_model_assumptions: Maximum-entropy restraints and biasing weights depend on target-observable definitions and an assumed simulation formulation.
source_objects.uncertainty_or_reliability_boundaries: The source does not supply an approved Rules-family routing or an operator contract for this batch.

atomic_source_supported_statements.statement: The abstract presents a maximum-entropy approach to enforce concordance with experimental observations using minimally biased restraints.
The introduction describes experiments as reporting geometry-sensitive equilibrium information in the method framing.

source_first_pass_a.source_relationship: No family is preassigned. This is a routing-abstention test, not authorization to construct an operator or add a family.
source_first_pass_a.maximum_source_supported_wording: The source supports recording target-observable and restraint/biasing semantics without committing to a canonical Rules route.
forbidden_generalizations: Auto-route the method to a new family or registered operator.
Treat a method paper as evidence that a specific simulation bias is valid in another case.
missing_information: No approved source-to-family mapping, case-specific target observable, or executor is supplied.
possible_reusable_review_obligations: Route unassigned sources to human review.
Do not infer a model action from source methodology.
source_first_pass_a.authority_boundary: Primary-source bounded record only; it does not establish annotation truth, source-science approval, Rule validity, or scientific support.

frozen_pattern_pass_b.applicability: No canonical family/rule is selected in a family-blind routing challenge.
required_evidence: source identity, exact locator, and unassigned routing state
dependency_chain: No approved routing decision; no RuleInstance or operator route.
frozen_pattern_pass_b.first_blocking_dependency: No approved family-routing or operator contract exists.
irrelevant_obligations: All F01-F07 evaluator obligations are inactive.

analyst_divergence_classification_before.claim_boundary: The analyst records a projection, not a RuleResult or scientific conclusion.
